description: Calculate the pay-per-fax price for sending a fax to a specific number. No API key required. Supported: USA, Canada, Australia, New Zealand and 39 more countries (same list as sendfaxfast.com); premium-rate numbers are not supported.

fax_number.description: Recipient fax number in E.164 format (e.g. +12125550100 for USA, +61212345678 for Australia, +911123456789 for India)

pages.description: Number of pages in the document (default: 1)

name: get_fax_price
title: Check fax price
